episodes.synopsis: After repelling the demonic invasion, Wang Ling hopes to finally be able to lead a peaceful life. Unfortunately for him, the arrival of a new student will upset his daily life.
episodes.title: Top Girl vs Top Girl

episodes.synopsis: After the destruction of the demon world, the demons were displaced in the human world. The Jiugong family sent their eldest daughter, Jiugong Ryoko, to study at the "Sixty Gates" of the Huaxiu Kingdom to secretly collect demons and send them back to Sun Island. Wang Ling and other people in and Jiugong Ryoko get along, gradually found her and the whole Jiugong family's true purpose ...... against the sky of the immortal king, and this time to secretly why the battle?
episodes.title: Froggy2's Birthday

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling and his friends set out to pick premium immortal herbs. They will quickly realize that they are not alone in the mountains.
episodes.title: It'll Be You, Silvie!

episodes.synopsis: Guo Hao's new familiar leaves no one indifferent. Stella is perpetually surrounded by a crowd of admirers, among which have crept individuals thirsty for unicorn blood.
episodes.title: Silvie's Uproar

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious swordswoman is stirring up trouble in Songhai by systematically challenging every sword-wielder she finds. At the same time, Jingke enters a rebellious phase and refuses to obey Wang Ling.
episodes.title: You Are My Sword

episodes.synopsis: The main clans of Songhai are gathered for the sale of the year, where they will have to fight to acquire priceless treasures. Meanwhile, Wang Ling is faced with concerns of an entirely different order.
episodes.title: It's My Round

episodes.synopsis: The Exorcists seem to have invaded Songhai City. Guo Hao takes a dim view of their presence, unlike Chen Chao who is not insensitive to the charisma of these newcomers.
episodes.title: Welcome To Join the Exorcist Team!

episodes.synopsis: For ten years, Zhuo Yi has been the undisputed hero of Songhai City. Unfortunately for him, his imposture is about to come to light.
episodes.title: A False Hero

episodes.synopsis: Wang Ling and his friends prepare to attend the Saints' Gala, an annual party held at the Sun family's Celestial Paradise. Wang Ling is going to have to prove himself if he is to be considered worthy of staying by Sun Rong's side.
episodes.title: Oaths On High Saint's Day

episodes.synopsis: In order to rise in her father's esteem, Yoshiko Kyûmiya is determined to steal the Sun Family's sacred staff. To achieve this, she will have to find a partner and infiltrate the Saints' Day gala.
episodes.title: The Sun Family's Sacred Cudgel Is Lost (Mission Accomplished Version)

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Lord Thunder, Wang Ling and Sun Rong investigate the theft of the sacred staff. They are about to uncover the dark plot that threatens Eternia.
episodes.title: A Daring Journey to Sunland

episodes.synopsis: After many years spent in the human world, Chienpaud's identity is murky. Now that Zhuo Yi has unraveled the secret of the Kyumiya Volcano, the time has come for the former demonic king to choose sides.
episodes.title: Reconciled
